summary: The main path creates all row delimiters and transfers the CSR matrix/vector before timing. The kernel is one warp per row and the compiled timed main increments the iteration counter after the launch stub, compares it to the requested count, and branches back; an ending event is then synchronized before elapsed-time retrieval and copying the result. Final sm86 code checks row bounds, walks every CSR position by lane-strides with vectorized chunks and a remainder, reduces and stores the sum.
